series: Michigan/Ohio Fieldwork — Great Lakes and Oak Openings
description: OER Learning Object modules documenting industrial-ecological land use history and Indigenous displacement at three Great Lakes and Oak Openings sites. Each module integrates forensic ecological reporting, black-and-white primary source photography analysis, and Shadow History methodology.

learning_objects.ecological_context: CCC-era Red Pine plantation grids (1930s–1940s) over native oak savanna; reforestation-as-industry documentation; active restoration via prescribed fire and mechanical pine removal
